description.value: Living Forest Cafe is the in-house dining experience at Living Forest Oceanside Campground & RV Park, a 53-acre waterfront property on the Nanaimo River estuary. The cafe operates seasonally in summer and donates its profits to charity each year since opening over a decade ago. Touring cyclists will find it a relaxed stop within a scenic oceanside campground that also offers Wi-Fi on the cafe patio.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Living Forest Cafe is a seasonal, in-house dining experience at Living Forest Oceanside Campground & RV Park, 6 Maki Road, Nanaimo, with phone (250) 755-1755. The Wi-Fi subpage explicitly names a café-patio network ('LivingForestCafe'), confirming free Wi-Fi at the cafe. No evidence on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms specific to the cafe, or menu details (takeout, dietary options); the campground has token showers but these are not described as publicly accessible to cafe-only visitors.
